deep_tech_definition: A deep tech company's product rests on substantial scientific or engineering R&D (new biology, chemistry, materials, physics, hardware or core AI research), usually with lab work, long development cycles or protectable IP. Applying existing software to a business process is not deep tech, even when it uses AI.
